manifest.selection_rule: five lowest image IDs; three lowest IDs for sweeps

negative_prompt_policy.text: blurry, distorted, low quality, duplicate, text, watermark

noise.algorithm: seeded CPU float32 normal, cast to contiguous CPU FP16 before transfer
noise.hash: SHA-256 of unscaled CPU FP16 tensor bytes in C order
